records.claim: Most studies have not found an increased chance of major birth defects with gabapentin use during pregnancy. A large study from the North American Antiepileptic Drug Pregnancy Registry found a major birth defect rate of 1.5% (4 out of 270 pregnancies) among pregnancies exposed to gabapentin. This is within the background chance of birth defects that can occur in any pregnancy (about 3%).
